resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Simplified Chinese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Simplified Chinese pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula-notation, circuit, thermal, and SI-prefix defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Simplified Chinese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current definition needed concise Chinese technical wording.
evidence: The previous bullet repeated an unnecessary unit description.
findings.resolution: Changed it to I 是电流，单位为安培（A）。

findings.summary: The limits paragraph used a literal phrase for non-ohmic components.
evidence: The previous paragraph said components could be non-ohm rather than non-ohmic.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it using 欧姆元件 and a natural Chinese explanation.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description did not name charge and energy as conserved quantities.
evidence: The previous description referred generally to conservation at nodes and closed loops.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation around closed loops.

findings.summary: The parallel-connection definition used 并行 rather than the standard circuit term 并联.
evidence: The previous bullet used 并行连接.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 并联连接.

findings.summary: The KVL paragraph used an awkward literal phrase for voltage rises and drops.
evidence: The previous paragraph used a literal algebraic-sum construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Chinese terms for voltage rise, drop, loop direction, and polarity.

findings.summary: The resistor-equation step used less direct relation wording.
evidence: The previous step used 联系起来 for voltage and current.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 用 V = I × R 关联电阻两端的电压和电流。

findings.summary: The TCR unit explanation needed clearer wording for the same temperature scale.
evidence: The previous bullet used a literal temperature-use construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to require the same temperature scale and units for T - T_0.

findings.summary: The TCR limitations paragraph used a literal phrase for material changes.
evidence: The previous paragraph used 材料变化 without clarifying material properties.
findings.resolution: Clarified material-property changes and deviation from the first-order estimate.

findings.summary: The triangle example title used a literal phrase for finding a side.
evidence: The previous title was 寻找一边.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 求边长.

findings.summary: The angle-mode paragraph used a literal full-cycle phrase.
evidence: The previous paragraph used 一个完整的周期 for a full rotation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with a natural statement about angle mode and one full rotation.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity conclusion omitted spacing and used a vague phrase for actual heater losses.
evidence: The previous text rendered 是41.8 kJ and said the real heater needs more without naming energy.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as ideal energy demand of 41.8 kJ plus additional energy for heat loss.

findings.summary: The phase-change paragraph used a literal term for specific latent heat.
evidence: The previous text used 比潜热 without explicitly defining it per unit mass.
findings.resolution: Clarified L as latent heat per unit mass in J/kg.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating heading used a wordy phrase.
evidence: The previous heading was 用电力加热.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise technical heading 电加热.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous name was 热通量.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 热流密度.

findings.summary: The heat-flux description omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous description said heat passes through a surface without stating each unit of area.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as heat transfer rate per unit area.

findings.summary: The q'' definition called the quantity heat flux instead of heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous bullet used q'' 是热通量.
findings.resolution: Changed it to q'' 是热流密度.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example title did not identify a density.
evidence: The previous title was 平均加热器通量.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 加热器平均热流密度.

findings.summary: The heat-flux conclusion used general heat flux rather than heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous conclusion began 平均热通量为.
findings.resolution: Changed it to average heat-flux density and retained both units.

findings.summary: The convection paragraph called h a surface coefficient.
evidence: The previous paragraph used 表面系数 h.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 对流系数 h and clarified absolute kelvin temperature.

findings.summary: The final heat-flux check used an awkward phrase about using heat capacity to change temperature.
evidence: The previous bullet said 利用热容来改变温度.
findings.resolution: Changed it to use heat capacity to calculate temperature change.

findings.summary: The SI heading called the entries common international units rather than base units.
evidence: The previous heading was 常用国际单位制.
findings.resolution: Changed it to SI 基本单位.

findings.summary: The SI table header translated symbol as 象征, meaning a symbolic emblem.
evidence: The previous header was 象征.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 符号.

findings.summary: The kilo prefix was translated as kilogram rather than kilo.
evidence: The previous prefix cell was 公斤.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 千.

findings.summary: The mega prefix symbol was translated as Chinese prose.
evidence: The previous symbol cell was 中号.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the SI symbol M.

findings.summary: The milli prefix symbol was translated as a Chinese word rather than m.
evidence: The previous symbol cell was 米.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the SI symbol m.
